text:
Your Otaru afternoon, in six steps 👇

1️⃣ Rapid Airport train from Sapporo.
About 41 minutes, ¥800.
Check it says Otaru.

2️⃣ Eat first at Sankaku Market.
Takinami Shokudo gives out numbered tickets.
Go early.

3️⃣ Walk about 10 minutes down to the canal.

4️⃣ Sakaimachi street.
The Music Box Museum is free to enter.

5️⃣ Back at the canal by about 16:00 in winter,
when the gas lamps come on.

6️⃣ Sushi-ya-dori for dinner.
Masazushi: last order 20:30, closed Wednesdays.

👉 Times, prices and where to stay:
https://japanbystation.com/otaru-from-sapporo-half-day-or-overnight
